findings.title: Manifest output can escape the repository through caller paths or symlinked parents
findings.what: main resolves `--out` without constraining it to the validated repository root (lines 271-275), while writeManifest creates and writes through its parent path (lines 230-235). Consequently an absolute/`..` output or a repository-controlled symlink such as `data` can redirect the host/CI write outside the checkout. The temporary filename is also predictable and opened without exclusive/no-follow protection, permitting a pre-existing symlink at that path to be followed before rename.
findings.fix: Reject output paths whose real parent is outside the real repository root, reject symlinked output path components, and create the temporary file atomically with exclusive creation (`wx`) in the validated destination directory before renaming it.
findings.acceptance: Add tests where `--out` uses `..`, where the default `data` parent is a symlink outside the fixture repository, and where the predicted temporary path is a symlink; each run must exit nonzero and leave every external target byte-identical, while a normal in-repository output still succeeds.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read scripts/doc-git-times-generate.mjs:228-275 at the immutable baseline. `resolve(out)` performs no containment check, `mkdirSync` accepts an existing symlinked directory, and `writeFileSync` follows an existing symlink; the dispatched tests contain no containment or no-follow assertion that invalidates the path.
